definition_friction.text: Your Body is the strength the whole of you stands on. Wood makes it a reach that keeps going once started. Running over, your push outgrows every plan and partner, because your own way is the one you trust. You press on and lose the people beside you.

definition_balanced.text: Your Body is the strength the whole of you stands on. Wood makes it growth, a reach fed by what goes in. In balance, what goes in keeps pace with the reach. You hold your own ground and still have space for a peer beside you.

catalyst_keywords: Does it alone: Doing it alone is where your strength shows. You trust your own hands before anyone's plan, and you finish what others are still waiting on. What you build is yours from the first nail to the last.

Sets own pace: Fast or slow around you, you move at your own speed. Being your own clock keeps you steady, since a borrowed pace never feels like yours. Nobody rushes you into a decision you would regret.

Consistent: You are the same person in any company. One standard for yourself keeps your footing, since a new shape for each group would cost you your measure. Friends never have to guess which you will turn up.

Goes first: You go first, with the plan half done and the vote not in. Waiting your turn feels like losing, since the opening is worth more to you than certainty. Others find their nerve by watching you move.
Loves a race: A race wakes you up like nothing else. Having someone just ahead is your best fuel, since a pace you can see beats one you must invent. What you want is a rival worth keeping up with.

Shares the risk: Given the choice, you put the stakes in a shared pot. Being in it together makes a risk worth taking, since a bet carried alone weighs more than one split. Your partners never face a bad loss by themselves.

catalyst_keywords: Gives freely: Giving is the easiest thing you do. You would rather be useful than be thanked, and you give before being asked. The people near you feel looked after before they know they need it.

Enjoys out loud: Enjoying something quietly was never your way. You feel a pleasure fully only once it is shared, and you would rather enjoy a small thing with company than a big thing alone. A dinner with you turns into an occasion.

Effortless: What you make comes out without strain. Ease is the sign you trust, and you would rather do the thing that flows than force the thing that counts. Your work has a lightness people feel at once.
Speaks up: You speak up right where it has gone quiet. You hear silence as agreeing, and you say the unsaid thing rather than sit with it. You are usually the only one who will.

Born performer: You change in front of an audience, for the better. Being watched is where your focus comes from, and you would rather perform a thing than practise it. Your best work happens live, and the crowd gets all of it.

Thinks fast: You think fastest with no time to think. You light up under pressure rather than freeze, so you answer on the spot instead of taking it away with you. On a deadline, everyone looks to you for the first word.

definition_catalyst.text: Your Action is what you go and build, claim and provide. Earth makes it steady, so what you claim lasts. As a catalyst, firm ground runs short and each gain counts for more than it should. Your cushion grows slowly and never quite feels like enough.

definition_friction.text: Your Action is what you go and build, claim and provide. Earth gives it weight, so whatever you claim needs keeping. As a friction, what you take on grows heavier than you can bear. Holding it is how you feel secure, and over time you carry more than you finish.

definition_balanced.text: Your Action is what you go and build, claim and provide. Earth makes it steady, so what you claim lasts. In balance, what you go after and what you hold grow at the same pace. You reach for the new while the old still pays.

definition_balanced.tail: In balance, what you go after and what you hold grow at the same pace. You reach for the new while the old still pays.

catalyst_keywords: Far-sighted: You see a chance long before anyone else wants it. Having somewhere next to go is your safety, so you watch where a thing is heading more than what it is. By the time others see the opening, you are already there.

Takes the chance: A chance within reach is hard to leave alone, because standing in place feels like losing. You take the one that is here rather than wait for a safer one. The doors you walk through are ones most people only look at.

Shares the win: A win only feels real to you once you have shared it. Providing is where you feel most yourself, and you share a good month rather than put it away. In a good year, everyone at your table eats well.

Makes things last: Making a thing last is a craft you practice without noticing. Waste feels to you like a small loss of control, so you repair what you own rather than replace it. Under your hands, old things keep earning their place.
Saves first: Saving comes first for you, before the treat and the trip. A cushion is what lets you relax, and you put money away rather than enjoy it. A bad month never finds you short.

Loyal: Being loyal costs you less than leaving ever would. The known thing keeps you safe, and you hold what is already yours instead of looking elsewhere. The people you stand by know exactly where to find you.

catalyst_keywords: Takes charge: Taking charge comes to you before anyone asks. A crisis gives your force a charge to carry, and you carry it yourself rather than wait for someone else to step up. At the worst moment, everyone steadies because you steadied first.

Thrives under pressure: Pressure is where you do your best work. A real stake lets you thrive where comfort lets you drift, and being tested suits you better than being at ease. A deadline that rattles others leaves you clear and steady.

Decides fast: Deciding fast is how you stop a crisis from deciding for you. A quick decision points your push somewhere, and you accept being wrong early rather than being right too late. While others are still weighing it, your call has already got people moving.

Keeps your word: Keeping your word is the standard you hold above every other. A promise is a rule of your own making, and you would rather carry a hard yes to the end than give an easy maybe. People build their plans on what you say.

Does it properly: Doing it properly is the only way you know. A rule gives your effort a shape, and you follow the proper procedure rather than any shortcut. Work that passes through your hands stands up to any inspection.

Earns your place: Earning your place counts for more with you than being handed one. Rank only feels earned when the rules gave it, and you choose the slow route rather than the shortcut. A title built step by step is one no rival takes from you.

definition_catalyst.text: Your Mind is where the world soaks in and becomes yours. Water makes it flow, and what goes in comes back later as instinct. As a catalyst, the intake runs short, but what does come in sinks far and stays. You know more by feel than by proof.

definition_friction.text: Your Mind is where the world soaks in and becomes yours. Here Water turns it deep, and understanding settles in you before words do. As a friction, the Mind fills faster than it empties, because knowing more feels safer than moving. The moment to act passes while you wait.

catalyst_keywords: Goes deep: Going deep is the only way you learn. Half-knowing bothers you more than not knowing at all, so you follow one question down until the floor shows. What you bring back up stays yours for life.

Reads people: You read what a person is not saying. A pause tells you more than the words around it, so you trust your feeling about someone over the story you are given. People feel understood around you before they have explained anything.

Self-taught: You teach yourself what matters most to you. A lesson you worked out alone sits deeper than one handed to you, and your own odd route comes before the course on offer. You lose years to the long way and would take it again.

Calming presence: You calm people down without trying to. Taking in someone's worry costs you less than watching them carry it, so you take it in and give back something steadier. Around you, frightened people find their feet again.

Soaks it up: You soak things up rather than study them. It settles into you from whatever is nearby, so you know a thing long before you can pass a test on it. Your grasp of a subject often goes deeper than anyone guesses.

Patient: Being patient comes easily to you. Letting a thing come in its own time feels more honest than forcing it, and you can wait on a question for months. Shy people and half-formed ideas both get a fair hearing from you.
